\"For Great Justice!\".description: Shout. For 8 seconds, whenever you hit with an attack, you gain 1 additional strikes of adrenaline.
\"For Great Justice!\".concise: Shout. (8 seconds.) You gain 1 extra strikes of adrenaline whenever you hit with an attack.

\"Watch Yourself!\".description: Shout. Party members within earshot gain +5...25 armor for 10 seconds. This shout ends after 1...3 incoming attacks.
\"Watch Yourself!\".concise: Shout. (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot have +5...25 armor. Ends after 1...3 incoming attacks.

Aegis.description: Enchantment Spell. For 1...3 seconds, target other party member cannot be the target of hostile spells, and attacks against this party member fail.
Aegis.concise: Enchantment Spell. (1...3 seconds.) Target party member cannot be targeted by hostile spells. Attacks against this party member fail. Cannot self-target.

Aura of Restoration.description: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, you gain 0...1 Energy and are healed for 200...400% of the Energy cost each time you cast a spell.
Aura of Restoration.concise: Enchantment Spell. (60 seconds.) You gain 0...1 Energy and are healed for 200...400% of the Energy cost each time you cast a spell.

triggers: You or ally casts a spell

Call of Haste.description: Shout. For 30 seconds, your animal companion has a 25% faster attack speed and moves 25% faster.
Call of Haste.concise: Shout. (30 seconds.) Your pet moves and attacks 25% faster.

Comfort Animal.description: Skill. You heal your animal companion for 40...120 Health. If your companion is dead, it is resurrected with 10...58% Health. If you have Comfort Animal equipped, your animal companion will travel with you.
Comfort Animal.concise: Skill. Your pet gains 40...120 Health. Resurrects your pet (10...58% Health). If you have Comfort Animal equipped, your animal companion will travel with you.

Crippling Anguish.description: Elite Hex Spell. For 5...20 seconds, target moves 50% slower and suffers -2...6 Health degeneration.
Crippling Anguish.concise: Elite Hex Spell. (5...20 seconds.) Target foe moves 50% slower and has -2...6 Health degeneration.

Crippling Shot.description: Elite Bow Attack. If Crippling Shot hits, your target becomes Crippled for 4...14 seconds. This attack cannot be blocked.
Crippling Shot.concise: Elite Bow Attack. Unblockable. Inflicts Crippled condition (4...14 seconds).

Defy Pain.description: Elite Stance. For 20 seconds, you have an additional 90...300 Health and an additional 20 armor.
Defy Pain.concise: Elite Stance. (20 seconds.) You have +90...300 maximum Health and +20 armor.

Empathy.description: Hex Spell. For 5...15 seconds, whenever target foe attacks, that foe takes 15...45 damage.
Empathy.concise: Hex Spell. (5...15 seconds.) Target foe takes 15...45 damage whenever it attacks.

Enfeeble.description: Spell. Target suffers from Weakness for 10...30 seconds.

Enfeebling Blood.description: Spell. Target foe and all nearby foes suffer from Weakness for 1...16 seconds.
Enfeebling Blood.concise: Spell. Inflicts Weakness condition (1...16 seconds) on this foe and nearby foes.

Escape.description: Elite Stance. For 1...8 seconds, you move 33% faster and have a 75% chance to block attacks. Escape ends if you make a melee attack.
Escape.concise: Elite Stance. (1...8 seconds.) You move 33% faster and have 75% chance to block. Ends if you make a melee attack.

Ether Renewal.description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, each time you cast a spell, you gain 1...3 Energy and 5...20 Health for each enchantment on you.
Ether Renewal.concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. (10 seconds.) Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1...3 Energy and 5...20 Health for each enchantment on you.

triggers: You or ally casts a spell

Fevered Dreams.description: Elite Hex Spell. For 5...15 seconds, whenever target foe suffers from a new condition, all foes in the area suffer from that condition as well.
Fevered Dreams.concise: Elite Hex Spell. (5...15 seconds.) Foes in the area also have any new conditions that target foe acquires.

Fragility.description: Hex Spell. For 8...20 seconds, target and adjacent foes take 5...20 damage each time they suffer or recover from a new condition.
Fragility.concise: Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to target (8...20 seconds). These foes take 5...20 damage each time they gain or lose a condition.

Frenzy.description: Stance. For 8 seconds, you attack 33% faster but take 200...150% damage.
Frenzy.concise: Stance. (8 seconds.) You attack 33% faster. You take 200...150% damage.

Heal Party.description: Spell. Heal entire party for 30...75 Health.

Hundred Blades.description: Elite Skill. For 15 seconds, whenever you attack with a sword, all adjacent foes take 10...30 slashing damage.
Hundred Blades.concise: Elite Skill. (15 seconds.) Deals 10...30 slashing damage to all adjacent foes whenever you attack with a sword.

Illusion of Haste.description: Enchantment Spell. For 5...11 seconds, you move 33% faster. When Illusion of Haste ends, you become Crippled for 3 seconds.
Illusion of Haste.concise: Enchantment Spell. (5...11 seconds.) You move 33% faster. End effect: you are Crippled (3 seconds).

Illusionary Weaponry.description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, your melee attacks neither hit nor fail to hit. Instead, Illusionary Weaponry deals 20...60 damage to your targets for each melee attack.
Illusionary Weaponry.concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Deals 20...60 damage to foes in place of other damage or effects from melee attacks. Your melee attacks neither hit nor fail to hit.

Lightning Reflexes.description: Stance. For 5...11 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block melee and projectile attacks, and you attack 33% faster.
Lightning Reflexes.concise: Stance. (5...11 seconds.) You attack 33% faster and have 75% chance to block.

Mantra of Resolve.description: Stance. For 5 seconds, you cannot be interrupted, but each time you would have been interrupted, you lose 10...4 Energy or Mantra of Resolve ends.
Mantra of Resolve.concise: Stance. (5 seconds.) Prevents interrupts against you. Prevention cost: lose 10...4 Energy or Mantra of Resolve ends.

Mantra of Signets.description: Stance. For 10...40 seconds, you have +3 armor for each signet you have equipped. Whenever you use a signet, you gain 5...60 Health.
Mantra of Signets.concise: Stance. (10...40 seconds.) You have +3 armor for each signet. You gain 5...60 Health each time you use a signet.

triggers: You or ally uses a skill

Melandru's Assault.description: Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Melandru's Assault that deals +5...20 damage. If that attack strikes a foe with an enchantment, that foe and all adjacent foes take +5...35 additional damage.
Melandru's Assault.concise: Pet Attack. Deals +5...20 damage. Deals +5...35 more damage to target and foes adjacent to target if this foe is enchanted.

Migraine.description: Elite Hex Spell. For 4...16 seconds, target foe suffers -1...8 Health degeneration and takes 100% longer to activate skills.
Migraine.concise: Elite Hex Spell. (4...16 seconds.) Causes -1...8 Health degeneration and doubles skill activation time.

Mind Freeze.description: Elite Hex Spell. Target foe takes 10...60 cold damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, that foe suffers an additional 10...60 cold damage and moves 90% slower for 1...5 seconds.
Mind Freeze.concise: Elite Hex Spell. Deals 10...60 cold damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, deals +10...60 cold damage and causes 90% slower movement (1...5 seconds).

Mind Shock.description: Elite Spell. Target foe suffers 10...50 lightning damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, that foe suffers 10...50 more lightning damage and is knocked down. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
Mind Shock.concise: Elite Spell. Deals 10...50 lightning damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, deals +10...50 lightning damage and causes knockdown. 25% armor penetration.

Mind Wrack.description: Hex Spell. For 5...40 seconds, whenever this foe is the target of one of your non-hex Mesmer skills, that foe loses 1 Energy. If the target foe's Energy drops to 0, Mind Wrack ends and that foe takes 15...100 damage.
Mind Wrack.concise: Hex Spell. (5...40 seconds.) Causes 1 Energy loss each time foe is the target of your non-hex Mesmer skills. If target foe's Energy drops to 0, Mind Wrack ends and that foe takes 15...100 damage.

Mist Form.description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10...45 seconds, you take 33% less damage from foes under the effect of Water Magic hexes. Whenever you cast an elemental spell, all non-spirit allies in earshot are healed for 50...250% of the Energy cost of the spell. This spell does not heal allies above 80% Health.
Mist Form.concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. (10...45 seconds.) Take 33% less damage from foes hexed with Water Magic. Heals non-spirit allies in earshot for 50...250% of the Energy cost of your elemental spells. Does not heal allies above 80% Health.

Nature's Renewal.description: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1...10 spirit. For 30...240 seconds, enchantments and hexes cast by non-spirit creatures take 50...75% longer to cast, and it costs twice as much Energy to maintain enchantments. This spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.
Nature's Renewal.concise: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...240 second lifespan). For creatures in range, enchantments and Hexes take 50...75% longer to cast and it costs twice as much Energy to maintain enchantments. Does not affect spirits.

Obsidian Flame.description: Spell. Deal 22...92 damage to target foe. This spell ignores armor.

Otyugh's Cry.description: Shout. For 5...15 seconds, your animal companion gains +24 armor and cannot be blocked.
Otyugh's Cry.concise: Shout. (5...15 seconds.) Your pet has +24 armor and is unblockable.

Peace and Harmony.description: Elite Enchantment Spell. Target ally loses 0...4 conditions and hexes. For 1...3 seconds, conditions and hexes expire 90% faster on that ally. All of your Smiting Prayers are disabled for 20 seconds.
Peace and Harmony.concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. Target ally loses 0...4 conditions and hexes. Conditions and hexes expire 90% faster on that ally (1...3 seconds). Disables your Smiting Prayers (20 seconds).

Penetrating Attack.description: Bow Attack. If Penetrating Attack hits, you strike for +5...15 damage and this attack has 10% armor penetration.
Penetrating Attack.concise: Bow Attack. Deals +5...15 damage. 10% armor penetration.

Protector's Strike.description: Melee Attack. If this attack strikes a moving foe, you strike for 10...40 more damage.
Protector's Strike.concise: Melee Attack. Deals +10...40 damage if target is moving.

Read the Wind.description: Preparation. For 24 seconds, your arrows move twice as fast.
Read the Wind.concise: Preparation. (24 seconds.) Your arrows move twice as fast.

Shatter Delusions.description: Spell. Remove one Mesmer hex from target foe. If a hex is removed, that foe takes 15...75 damage and all adjacent foes take 75% of that damage.
Shatter Delusions.concise: Spell. Removes a Mesmer hex from target foe. Removal effect: 15...75 damage to target and 75% of that damage to all adjacent foes.

Signet of Agony.description: Signet. You suffer from Bleeding for 25 seconds. All nearby foes take 10...70 damage.
Signet of Agony.concise: Signet. Deals 10...70 damage to foes near you. You begin Bleeding (25 seconds).

Signet of Judgment.description: Elite Signet. Target foe is knocked down. That foe and all adjacent foes take 5...50 holy damage. This signet has half the normal range.
Signet of Judgment.concise: Elite Half Range Signet. Knocks down target. Deals 5...50 holy damage to target and adjacent foes.

Strength of Honor.description: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, target ally deals 1...5 more damage in melee.
Strength of Honor.concise: Enchantment Spell. Target ally deals 1...5 more damage in melee.

Unholy Feast.description: Spell. Steal up to 10...65 Health from up to 1...4 foes in the area.
Unholy Feast.concise: Spell. Steals 10...65 Health from 1...4 foes in the area around you.

Unyielding Aura.description: Elite Enchantment Spell. Bring target dead party member back to life at full Health and full Energy. If you stop maintaining this enchantment or if this enchantment is removed, that party member dies and leaves an exploited corpse. Deaths while enchanted with Unyielding Aura do not incur a death penalty. (50% failure chance with Divine Favor 4 or less.)
Unyielding Aura.concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. Resurrects target party member (full Health, full Energy). End effect: this ally dies and leaves an exploited corpse. Does not incur a death penalty. 50% failure chance unless Divine Favor 5 or more.

Ward Against Harm.description: Elite Ward Spell. Create a Ward Against Harm at this location. For 5...15 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area have +1...3 Health regeneration, +12...24 armor, and an additional +12...24 armor against elemental damage. This spell is disabled for 30 seconds.
Ward Against Harm.concise: Elite Ward Spell. (5...15 seconds.) Allies in this ward have +1...3 Health regeneration, +12...24 armor, and +12...24 additional armor against elemental damage. Spirits are unaffected. This spell is disabled for 30 seconds.

Warrior's Endurance.description: Elite Stance. For 5...35 seconds, you gain 3 Energy each time you hit with a melee attack. Warrior's Endurance cannot raise your Energy above 10...25.
Warrior's Endurance.concise: Elite Stance. (5...35 seconds.) You gain 3 Energy each time you hit with a melee attack. No Energy gain if you have more than 10...25 Energy.

Wastrel's Worry.description: Hex Spell. After 3 seconds, target foe takes 20...100 damage and all adjacent foes take 75% of that damage. If that foe successfully uses a skill, Wastrel's Worry ends prematurely and does no damage.
Wastrel's Worry.concise: Hex Spell. (3 seconds.) End effect: causes 20...100 damage to target and 75% of that damage to adjacent foes. No effect and ends early if target foe uses a skill.

\"Coward!\".description: Elite Shout. If target foe is moving, that foe is knocked down.
\"Coward!\".concise: Elite Shout. Causes knock-down if target foe is moving.

Accumulated Pain.description: Spell. Target foe takes 10...35 damage. If target foe is suffering from 2 or more hexes, that foe suffers a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
Accumulated Pain.concise: Spell. Deals 10...35 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds) if target foe has 2 or more hexes.

Ancestors' Rage.description: Skill. For 3 seconds all foes adjacent to target ally take 4...50 lightning damage each second.
Ancestors' Rage.concise: Skill. (3 seconds.) Deals 4...50 lightning damage to foes adjacent to target ally each second.

Armor of Unfeeling.description: Enchantment Spell. For 10...35 seconds, you have 10 base damage reduction while casting binding rituals.
Armor of Unfeeling.concise: Enchantment Spell. (10...35 seconds.) You have 10 base damage reduction while casting binding rituals.

Auspicious Blow.description: Hammer Attack. If Auspicious Blow hits, you strike for +5...20 damage and gain 2...4 Energy. If target foe is suffering from Weakness, this attack is unblockable.
Auspicious Blow.concise: Hammer Attack. Deals +5...20 damage and you gain 2...4 Energy. Unblockable if target foe is Weakened.

Bloodsong.description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...8 spirit who dies after 30...150 seconds. Attacks by that spirit steal up to 5...25 Health.
Bloodsong.concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...8 spirit (30...150 second lifespan). Its attacks steal 5...25 Health.

Dash.description: Stance. For 3 seconds, you run 50% faster. Every 2 points in Shadow Arts lowers recharge by 1 seconds (max 6 seconds).
Dash.concise: Stance. (3 seconds.) You move 50% faster. Every 2 points in Shadow Arts lowers recharge by 1 seconds (max 6 seconds).

Death Blossom.description: Dual Attack. Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, Death Blossom strikes target foe for +20...45 damage and all adjacent foes take 20...45 damage.
Death Blossom.concise: Dual Attack. Deals +20...45 damage. Also affects foes adjacent to target foe. Must follow an off-hand attack.

Destruction.description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...10 Spirit that dies after 30 seconds. When this Spirit dies, all foes in the area take 1...10 damage for each second the Spirit was alive (maximum of 150 damage).
Destruction.concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30 second lifespan). On death, it deals 1...10 damage for each second it was alive to all foes in the area (maximum 150 damage).

Discord.description: Elite Spell. If target foe is suffering from a condition and under the effects of a hex or an enchantment, that foe suffers 30...110 damage.
Discord.concise: Elite Spell. Deals 30...110 damage. No effect unless target foe has a condition and is either hexed or enchanted.

Disenchantment.description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...8 spirit. This spirit deals 5...20 damage and anyone struck by its attack loses one enchantment. This spirit dies after 15...40 seconds.
Disenchantment.concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...8 spirit (15...40 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5...20 damage and remove one enchantment.

Displacement.description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...10 spirit. All non-spirit allies within its range have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks. Every time an attack is blocked in this way, this spirit takes 60 damage. This spirit dies after 30...60 seconds.
Displacement.concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...60 second lifespan). Non-spirit allies within range have 75% chance to block. Block effect: this spirit takes 60 damage.

Dissonance.description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...8 spirit. This spirit deals 5...20 damage and anyone struck by its attack is interrupted. This spirit dies after 10...25 seconds.
Dissonance.concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...8 spirit (10...25 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5...20 damage and interrupt actions.

Earthbind.description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...10 spirit. All non-spirit foes knocked down within its range are knocked down for at least 3 seconds. Whenever this happens, this spirit loses 50...25 Health. This spirit dies after 15...45 seconds.
Earthbind.concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...10 spirit (15...45 second lifespan). Any time non-spirit foes within range are knocked-down, they are knocked down for at least 3 seconds. Knock-down cost: this spirit loses 50...25 Health.

Enraged Lunge.description: Elite Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts an Enraged Lunge that deals +3...23 damage (maximum bonus 60) for each recharging Beast Mastery skill.
Enraged Lunge.concise: Elite Pet Attack. Deals +3...23 damage (maximum 60) for each of your recharging Beast Mastery skills.

Enraged Smash.description: Elite Hammer Attack. If Enraged Smash hits, you gain 1...3 strikes of adrenaline. If you hit a moving foe, you strike for +10...40 damage, and your target is knocked down.
Enraged Smash.concise: Elite Hammer Attack. Gives you 1...3 strikes of adrenaline if you hit. Deals +10...40 damage and causes knockdown if your target was moving.

Flesh of My Flesh.description: Spell. Lose half your Health. Resurrect target party member with your current Health and 5...20% Energy.
Flesh of My Flesh.concise: Spell. Resurrects target party member (half your current Health and 5...20% Energy). Lose half your Health.

Fox Fangs.description: Off-Hand Attack. Must follow a lead attack. Fox Fangs cannot be blocked and strikes for +10...25 damage if it hits.
Fox Fangs.concise: Off-Hand Attack. Deals +10...25 damage. Unblockable. Must follow a lead attack.

Glass Arrows.description: Elite Preparation. For 10...35 seconds, your arrows strike for +6...18 damage if they hit and cause Bleeding for 10...20 seconds if they are Blocked.
Glass Arrows.concise: Elite Preparation. (10...35 seconds.) Your arrows deal +6...18 damage. Inflicts Bleeding condition if blocked (10...20 seconds).

Guided Weapon.description: Weapon Spell. For 4...10 seconds, target ally's attacks cannot be blocked.
Guided Weapon.concise: Weapon Spell. (4...10 seconds.) Attacks are unblockable.

Heal as One.description: Elite Skill. If you or your animal companion are below 75% Health, you are both healed for 25...145 Health. If your companion is dead, it is resurrected with 50% Health.
Heal as One.concise: Elite Skill. Heals you and your pet for 25...145. If your pet is dead, it is resurrected with 50% Health. No effect if neither you nor your pet are below 75% Health.

Illusion of Pain.description: Hex Spell. For 8 seconds, target foe has -3...10 Health degeneration and takes 3...10 damage each second. When Illusion of Pain ends or is reapplied, that foe is healed for 36...120.
Illusion of Pain.concise: Hex Spell. (8 seconds.) Causes -3...10 Health degeneration and target foe takes 3...10 damage each second. End effect: that foe is healed for 36...120. Ends if reapplied.

Life.description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...10 spirit. When this spirit dies, all non-spirit allies within its range are healed for 1...7 Health for each second this spirit was alive. This spirit dies after 20 seconds.
Life.concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...10 spirit (20 second lifespan). Affects non-spirit allies within range. End effect: heals for 1...7 for each second this spirit was alive.

Lightning Hammer.description: Spell. Target foe is struck for 10...100 lightning damage. Lightning Hammer has 25% armor penetration.
Lightning Hammer.concise: Spell. Deals 10...100 lightning damage. 25% armor penetration.

Melandru's Shot.description: Elite Bow Attack. If Melandru's Shot hits, your target begins Bleeding for 5...25 seconds. If it hits a foe that is moving or knocked down, that foe takes +10...25 damage and is Crippled for 5...15 seconds.
Melandru's Shot.concise: Elite Bow Attack. Inflicts Bleeding (5...25 seconds). Deals +10...25 damage and inflicts Crippled (5...15 seconds) if target foe was moving or knocked down.

Pain.description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...8 spirit. This spirit's attacks deal 5...30 damage. This spirit dies after 30...150 seconds.
Pain.concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...8 spirit (30...150 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5...30 damage.

Predatory Bond.description: Shout. For 5...20 seconds, successful attacks by your animal companion heal you for 1...31 Health.
Predatory Bond.concise: Shout. (5...20 seconds.) You gain 1...31 Health whenever your pet makes a successful attack.

Preservation.description: Elite Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...10 spirit. Every 4 seconds, this spirit heals one non-spirit ally in the area for 10...115 Health. This spirit dies after 90 seconds.
Preservation.concise: Elite Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...10 spirit (90 second lifespan). Every 4 seconds, this spirit heals one non-spirit ally for 10...115.

Primal Rage.description: Elite Stance. For 1...9 seconds, you attack 33% faster and move 33% faster, but you take 200...150% damage.
Primal Rage.concise: Elite Stance. (1...9 seconds.) You attack 33% faster and move 33% faster. You take 200...150% damage.

Protector's Defense.description: Skill. For 4...8 seconds, allies adjacent to you have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks. Protector's Defense ends if you move.
Protector's Defense.concise: Skill. (4...8 seconds.) Allies adjacent to you have 75% chance to block. Ends if you move.

Psychic Instability.description: Elite Spell. Interrupts the target foe's action. If that action is a skill, that foe and all adjacent foes are knocked down for 2...3 seconds. (50% failure chance with Fast Casting 4 or less.)
Psychic Instability.concise: Elite Spell. Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: if the action is a skill, causes knockdown for 2...3 seconds on target foe and all adjacent foes. 50% failure chance unless Fast Casting 5 or higher.

Recuperation.description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...10 spirit. Non-spirit allies within its range gain +1...3 Health regeneration. This spirit dies after 15...45 seconds.
Recuperation.concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...10 spirit (15...45 second lifespan). Non-spirit allies within range have +1...3 Health regeneration.

Renewing Smash.description: Hammer Attack. If Renewing Smash hits, it deals +5...20 damage. If you hit a knocked-down foe, you gain 3 Energy and this attack recharges instantly.
Renewing Smash.concise: Hammer Attack. Deals +5...20 damage. You gain 3 Energy and this attack recharges instantly if target foe was knocked down.

Restoration.description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...10 spirit. When this spirit dies, all party members in the area are resurrected with 5...50% Health and zero Energy. This spirit dies after 30 seconds.
Restoration.concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30 second lifespan). End effect: resurrects party members in the area with 5...50% Health and zero Energy.

Ride the Lightning.description: Elite Spell. You Ride the Lightning to target. All adjacent foes are Blinded for 1...5 seconds. If your target is a foe, it is struck for 10...70 lightning damage. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
Ride the Lightning.concise: Elite Spell. Deals 10...70 lightning damage. 25% armor penetration. Blinds all adjacent foes (1...5 seconds). You instantly move to your target. May target allies.

Shadow Form.description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5...15 seconds, all hostile spells that target you fail and all attacks against you miss. When Shadow Form ends, lose all but 5...50 Health.
Shadow Form.concise: Elite Enchantment Spell. (5...15 seconds.) Hostile spells targeting you fail, and attacks against you miss. End effect: lose all but 5...50 Health.

Shadow Shroud.description: Elite Hex Spell. For 2...7 seconds, target foe cannot be the target of enchantments.
Shadow Shroud.concise: Elite Hex Spell. (2...7 seconds.) Target foe cannot be the target of enchantments.

Shadowsong.description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...6 spirit. This spirit's attacks deal 5...20 damage and cause Blindness for 1...6 seconds. This spirit dies after 30 seconds.
Shadowsong.concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...6 spirit (30-second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5...20 damage and inflict Blindness condition (1...6 seconds).

Shared Burden.description: Elite Hex Spell. For 5...20 seconds, target foe and all foes in the area attack, cast spells, and move 33% slower.
Shared Burden.concise: Elite Hex Spell. Also hexes foes in the area of your target (5...20 seconds). These foes attack, cast spells, and move 33% slower.

Shelter.description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...8 spirit. Non-spirit allies within its range cannot lose more than 10% maximum Health from a single attack. When this spirit prevents damage, it loses 75...45 Health. This spirit lasts 30...60 seconds.
Shelter.concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...8 spirit (30...60 second lifespan). Non-spirit allies within range cannot lose more than 10% maximum Health from a single attack. Damage prevention cost: this spirit loses 75...45 Health.

Shield Guardian.description: Enchantment Spell. For 1...4 seconds, all party members in earshot have a 75% chance to block attacks. If an attack is blocked, all allies in earshot are healed for 10...35 Health and Shield Guardian ends.
Shield Guardian.concise: Enchantment Spell. (1...4 seconds). Party members in earshot have a 75% chance to block attacks. Block effect: Allies in earshot are healed for 10...35 and Shield Guardian ends.

Shroud of Distress.description: Enchantment Spell. For 30...60 seconds, if you are below 50% Health, you have a 75% chance to block attacks.
Shroud of Distress.concise: Enchantment Spell. (30...60 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block. No effect unless your Health is below 50%.

Signet of Spirits.description: Elite Signet. You gain 3...12 Energy if you are within earshot of a spirit.
Signet of Spirits.concise: Elite Signet. You gain 3...12 Energy. No effect unless you are within earshot of a spirit.

Soothing.description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...8 spirit. All foes within its range take twice as long to build adrenaline. This spirit dies after 15...45 seconds.
Soothing.concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...8 spirit (15...45 second lifespan). Building adrenaline takes twice as long for foes within range.

Soul Twisting.description: Elite Skill. For 5...45 seconds, your Binding Rituals cost 15 less Energy (minimum 5) and recharge 25...50% faster. Soul Twisting ends after 1...3 Binding Rituals.
Soul Twisting.concise: Elite Skill. (5...45 seconds.) Your Binding Rituals cost 15 less Energy (minimum 5) and recharge 25...50% faster. Ends after 1...3 Binding Rituals.

Spirit Bond.description: Enchantment Spell. For 8 seconds, whenever target ally takes more than 50 damage from the next 10 attacks or spells, that ally is healed for 30...90 Health.
Spirit Bond.concise: Enchantment Spell. (8 seconds.) Heals for 30...90 whenever target ally takes more than 50 damage. Ends after this ally takes damage from 10 attacks or spells.

Splinter Weapon.description: Weapon Spell. For 20 seconds, target ally has a Splinter Weapon. Target ally's next 1...5 attacks deal 5...40 damage to up to 4 adjacent foes.
Splinter Weapon.concise: Weapon Spell. (20 seconds.) Attacks deal 5...40 damage to 3 adjacent foes. Ends after 1...5 attacks.

Spoil Victor.description: Elite Hex Spell. For 3...15 seconds, whenever target foe attacks or casts a spell on a creature with less Health that foe loses 15...75 Health.
Spoil Victor.concise: Elite Hex Spell. (3...15 seconds.) Causes 15...75 Health loss whenever target foe attacks or casts spells on a creature with less Health.

Stolen Speed.description: Elite Hex Spell. For 1...10 seconds, spells cast by the target foe and all adjacent foes take 100% longer to cast. Spells you cast that target these foes take 50% less time to cast.
Stolen Speed.concise: Elite Hex Spell. Also hexes adjacent foes (1...10 seconds). Doubles spell casting time. Spells you cast on hexed foes have -50% casting time.

Sundering Attack.description: Bow Attack. If Sundering Attack hits, you strike for +5...15 damage and this attack has 10% armor penetration.
Sundering Attack.concise: Bow Attack. Deals +5...15 damage. 10% armor penetration.

Tranquility.description: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1...10 spirit. Enchantments cast by non-spirit creatures within its range expire 10...30% faster. This spirit dies after 15...120 seconds.
Tranquility.concise: Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1...10 spirit (15...120 second lifespan). Enchantments expire 10...30% faster on creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.

Union.description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...8 spirit. Whenever a non-spirit ally in its range takes damage or life steal, it is reduced by 15 and the spirit takes 15 damage. This spirit dies after 30...60 seconds.
Union.concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...8 spirit (30...60 second lifespan). Whenever a non-spirit ally within range takes damage or life steal, it is reduced by 15 and the spirit takes 15 damage.

Unnatural Signet.description: Signet. Target foe takes 10...60 damage. If that foe is under the effects of a hex or enchantment, foes adjacent to your target take 10...60 damage. All your non-Mesmer skills except signets are disabled for 10 seconds.
Unnatural Signet.concise: Signet. Deals 10...60 damage. Deals 10...60 damage to other adjacent foes if the target is hexed or enchanted. Your non-Mesmer skills except signets are disabled (10 seconds).

Unseen Fury.description: Stance. For 15...60 seconds, you cannot be blocked by Blinded foes.
Unseen Fury.concise: Stance. (15...60 seconds.) You cannot be blocked by Blinded foes.

Wanderlust.description: Elite Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...8 spirit. Whenever this spirit's attack hits a stationary foe, that foe is knocked down and the spirit loses 70...50 Health. This spirit dies after 30...60 seconds.
Wanderlust.concise: Elite Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...8 spirit (30...60 second lifespan). Its attacks against stationary foes cause knock-down. Knock-down cost: this spirit loses 70...50 Health.

Weapon of Warding.description: Weapon Spell. For 3...8 seconds, target ally has a Weapon of Warding, granting that ally +2...4 Health regeneration and a 50% chance to block. Weapon of Warding ends if that ally attacks.
Weapon of Warding.concise: Weapon Spell. (3...8 seconds.) +2...4 Health regeneration. 50% chance to block. Ends if target ally attacks.

Wild Strike.description: Off-Hand Attack. Must follow a lead attack. If it hits, this attack strikes for +10...35 damage and any stance being used by target foe ends. This attack cannot be blocked.
Wild Strike.concise: Off-Hand Attack. Deals +10...35 damage. Removes target foe's stance. Unblockable. Must follow a lead attack.

\"Brace Yourself!\".description: Shout. For 5...15 seconds, the next time target other ally would be knocked down, 1 nearby foe takes 15...90 damage instead.
\"Brace Yourself!\".concise: Shout. (5...15 seconds.) Prevents the next knock-down and deals 15...90 damage to one foe near target ally. Cannot self-target.

\"Can't Touch This!\".description: Shout. For 20 seconds, the next 1...5 touch skills used against you fail.
\"Can't Touch This!\".concise: Shout. (20 seconds.) The next 1...5 touch-range skills used against you fail.

\"Fall Back!\".description: Shout. For 4...10 seconds, all allies within earshot gain 5...15 Health per second while moving and move 33% faster. "Fall Back!" ends on an ally affected by this shout when that ally successfully hits with an attack.
\"Fall Back!\".concise: Shout. (4...10 seconds.) Allies in earshot gain 5...15 Health per second while moving and move 33% faster. Ends for an ally if that ally hits with an attack.

\"Find Their Weakness!\".description: Shout. For 5...20 seconds, the next time target ally criticals, that ally also inflicts a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
\"Find Their Weakness!\".concise: Shout. (5...20 seconds.) Target ally inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds) with the next critical hit.

\"Go for the Eyes!\".description: Shout. For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot makes an attack, that attack has an additional 30...75% chance to critical.
\"Go for the Eyes!\".concise: Shout. (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot have +30...75% chance to land a critical hit with their next attack.

\"Help!\".description: Shout. Target non-spirit ally gains 5...50 Health. For 1...10 seconds, other allies' spells targeting that ally cast 50% faster.
\"Help!\".concise: Shout. (1...10 seconds.) Target non-spirit ally gains 5...50 health, allied spells targeting them cast 50% faster.

\"Incoming!\".description: Elite Shout. For 4...10 seconds, all allies within earshot move 33% faster and gain 5...15 Health per second while moving.
\"Incoming!\".concise: Elite Shout. (4...10 seconds.) Allies in earshot move 33% faster and gain 5...15 Health per second while moving.

\"Never Give Up!\".description: Shout. All allies within earshot and below 75% Health gain 1...10 Energy.
\"Never Give Up!\".concise: Shout. Allies in earshot gain 1...10 Energy. Only affects allies below 75% Health.

\"Never Surrender!\".description: Shout. For 10 seconds, all party members within earshot and below 75% Health gain +1...5 Health regeneration.
\"Never Surrender!\".concise: Shout. (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain +1...5 Health regeneration. Only affects party members below 75% Health.

\"Stand Your Ground!\".description: Shout. For 5...20 seconds, all party members within earshot receive +24 armor when not moving. This effect ends on an ally affected by this shout when that ally attacks.
\"Stand Your Ground!\".concise: Shout. (5...20 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain +24 armor when not moving. Ends for an ally if that ally attacks.

\"We Shall Return!\".description: Shout. For 10 seconds, whenever party members within earshot use a resurrection skill, their fallen allies return with 10...75% more Health and 5...50% more Energy.
\"We Shall Return!\".concise: Shout. (10 seconds.) Whenever party members in earshot use a resurrection skill, their fallen allies return with 10...75% more Health and 5...50% more Energy.

triggers: You or ally uses a skill

Anguish.description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...7 spirit. This spirit's attacks deal 5...20 damage and deal double damage to hexed foes. This spirit dies after 15...45 seconds.
Anguish.concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...7 spirit (15...45 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5...20 damage. Double damage to hexed foes.

Anthem of Envy.description: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each ally within earshot deals +10...20 damage against foes with more than 50% Health.
Anthem of Envy.concise: Chant. (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot do +10...20 damage with their next attack skill. Damage bonus only applies to foes with more than 50% Health.

Assassin's Remedy.description: Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, the next 1...10 attack skills you use remove one condition.
Assassin's Remedy.concise: Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Your next 1...10 attack skills each remove one condition.

Aura of Thorns.description: Flash Enchantment Spell. All nearby foes begin Bleeding for 5...15 seconds. For 30 seconds, this enchantment does nothing. When this enchantment ends, all nearby foes are Crippled for 3...8 seconds.
Aura of Thorns.concise: Flash Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Initial effect: inflicts Bleeding condition (5...15 seconds) on nearby foes. End effect: inflicts Crippled condition (3...8 seconds) on nearby foes.

Avatar of Dwayna.description: Elite Form. For 10...90 seconds, your attacks deal holy damage. Whenever you use a Dervish attack skill, you lose 1 hex. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, you are healed for 5...50 Health. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
Avatar of Dwayna.concise: Elite Form. (10...90 seconds.) Deal holy damage. You lose 1 hex whenever you use a Dervish attack skill. Heal yourself for 5...50 Health whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.

Avatar of Melandru.description: Elite Form. For 10...90 seconds, you have +100 Health, +30 elemental armor, and your attacks deal earth damage. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment you lose 2 conditions. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
Avatar of Melandru.concise: Elite Form. (10...90 seconds.) You have +100 maximum Health, +30 elemental armor, and your attacks deal earth damage. Cure 2 conditions from yourself whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.

Ballad of Restoration.description: Chant. For 10 seconds, the next time each party member within earshot takes damage, that party member gains 15...75 Health.
Ballad of Restoration.concise: Chant. (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain 15...75 Health the next time they take damage.

Banishing Strike.description: Melee Attack. If it hits, this attack deals 10...60 holy damage. It deals double damage to summoned creatures.
Banishing Strike.concise: Melee Attack. Deals 10...60 holy damage. Deals double damage to summoned creatures.

Bladeturn Refrain.description: Echo. For 20 seconds, target non-spirit ally has +10...40 armor against slashing damage. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on that ally.
Bladeturn Refrain.concise: Echo. (20 seconds.) Target ally has +10...40 armor against slashing damage. Renewal: Whenever a chant or shout ends on that ally. Cannot target spirits.

Blazing Finale.description: Echo. For 10...35 seconds, whenever a chant or shout ends on target non-spirit ally, all foes adjacent to that ally are set on Fire for 1...5 seconds.
Blazing Finale.concise: Echo. (10...35 seconds.) Inflicts Burning condition (1...5 seconds) to adjacent foes whenever a chant or shout ends on target ally. Cannot target spirits.

Charging Strike.description: Elite Stance. For 1...10 seconds, you run 33% faster. Your next successful melee hit does +10...80 damage and this stance ends. This stance ends if you use a skill.
Charging Strike.concise: Elite Stance. (1...10 seconds.) You move 33% faster and deal +10...80 damage with your next melee hit. Ends when you hit or if you use a skill.

Death Pact Signet.description: Signet. Resurrect target party member with your current Health and 15...100% maximum Energy. The next time that ally dies within 120 seconds, so do you.
Death Pact Signet.concise: Signet. Resurrects target party member with your current Health and 15...100% maximum Energy. For 120 seconds, you die the next time this party member dies.

Defensive Anthem.description: Elite Chant. For 4...10 seconds, each party member within earshot has a 50% chance to block incoming attacks. This chant ends if that party member hits with an attack skill.
Defensive Anthem.concise: Elite Chant. (4...10 seconds.) Party members in earshot have 50% chance to block. Ends when hitting with an attack skill.

Destructive Was Glaive.description: Elite Item Spell. Hold Glaive's ashes for up to 30...60 seconds. While you hold her ashes, all Ritualist skills have 10% armor penetration. When you drop her ashes, all foes in the area are struck for 15...85 lightning damage.
Destructive Was Glaive.concise: Elite Item Spell. (30...60 seconds.) Your Ritualist skills have 10% armor penetration. Drop effect: deals 15...85 lightning damage to all foes in the area.

Dust Cloak.description: Flash Enchantment Spell. All nearby foes are struck for 10...40 earth damage. For 30 seconds, your attacks deal earth damage. When this enchantment ends, all nearby foes are Blinded for 1...4 seconds.
Dust Cloak.concise: Flash Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Your attacks deal earth damage. Initial effect: deals 10...40 earth damage to nearby foes. End effect: inflicts Blindness condition (1...4 seconds) on nearby foes.

Elemental Flame.description: Enchantment Spell. For 5...20 seconds, whenever you apply an Elemental hex to a foe, that foe is set on fire for 1...2 seconds.
Elemental Flame.concise: Enchantment Spell. (5...20 seconds.) Inflicts Burning condition (1...2 seconds) whenever you apply an Elemental hex to a target.

Empowerment.description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...10 spirit. All allies within its range holding an item gain 15...45 maximum Health and 10 maximum Energy. This spirit dies after 15...60 seconds.
Empowerment.concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...10 spirit (15...60 second lifespan). Allies in range holding an item gain 15...45 maximum Health and 10 maximum Energy.

Enchanter's Conundrum.description: Elite Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, target foe casts enchantments 100...200% slower. If target foe is not under the effects of an enchantment when this hex is applied, that foe takes 10...100 damage and all adjacent foes take 75% of that damage.
Enchanter's Conundrum.concise: Elite Hex Spell. Causes 100...200% slower enchantment casting (10 seconds). Initial effect: if target foe is not enchanted deals 10...100 damage to target and 75% of that damage to adjacent foes.

Expert's Dexterity.description: Elite Stance. For 1...20 seconds, you attack 15% faster and your Marksmanship attribute is increased by 1.
Expert's Dexterity.concise: Elite Stance. (1...20 seconds.) You attack 15% faster and you gain +1 to your Marksmanship attribute.

Finale of Restoration.description: Echo. For 10...35 seconds, the next 5 times that a chant or shout ends on target non-spirit ally, that ally is healed for 15...75 Health.
Finale of Restoration.concise: Echo. (10...35 seconds.) Target ally gains 15...75 Health the next 5 times a shout or chant ends on that ally. Cannot target spirits.

Flail.description: Stance. For 1...15 seconds, you attack 33% faster but move 33% slower. Ends if you use a ranged attack skill.
Flail.concise: Stance. (1...15 seconds.) You attack 33% faster. Ends if you use a ranged attack skill. You move 33% slower.

Fleeting Stability.description: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 2...8 seconds, you cannot be knocked down and move 25% faster. This enchantment ends prematurely if it prevents a knockdown.
Fleeting Stability.concise: Flash Enchantment Spell. (2...8 seconds.) You cannot be knocked down and move 25% faster. Ends if knockdown prevented.

Frustration.description: Hex Spell. For 5...20 seconds, target foe casts spells 50% slower and takes 5...50 damage whenever interrupted.
Frustration.concise: Hex Spell. (5...20 seconds.) Causes 50% slower spell casting. Target foe takes 5...50 damage whenever interrupted.

Gaze of Fury.description: Binding Ritual. Destroy target allied spirit and create a level 1...10 Spirit of Fury. This spirit's attacks deal 5...20 damage. This spirit dies after 30...60 seconds.
Gaze of Fury.concise: Binding Ritual. Destroys an allied spirit. Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...60 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5...20 damage.

Guiding Hands.description: Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, your next 0...3 attacks cannot be blocked. When activated, this skill removes the Blindness condition.
Guiding Hands.concise: Enchantment Spell. (20 seconds.) Your next 0...3 attacks cannot be blocked. Initial effect: removes Blindness.

Harrier's Grasp.description: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 5...20 seconds, melee attacks against moving foes also Cripple those foes for 2...9 seconds. When you cast this enchantment, you are relieved of Cripple and 1 other condition. This enchantment ends after you apply Cripple 1...3 times.
Harrier's Grasp.concise: Flash Enchantment Spell. (5...20 seconds.) Melee attacks on moving foes also Cripple them. Initial Effect: you lose Cripple and 1 other condition. Ends after applying cripple 1...3 times.

Harrier's Toss.description: Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5...20 damage. If this attack hits a moving foe, it deals an additional 5...40 damage.
Harrier's Toss.concise: Spear Attack. Deals +5...20 damage. Deals 5...40 more damage if target is moving.

Heart of Fury.description: Stance. For 2...10 seconds, you attack 25% faster.

Infuriating Heat.description: Elite Nature Ritual. Create a level 1...10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within its range gain adrenaline 33...66% as fast. This spirit dies after 30...120 seconds.
Infuriating Heat.concise: Elite Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...120 second lifespan). Adrenaline gain increased by 33...66% for creatures in range.

Irresistible Sweep.description: Scythe Attack. Deal +3...15 damage and lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If you lose an enchantment in this way, Irresistible Sweep cannot be blocked and removes a stance.
Irresistible Sweep.concise: Scythe Attack. Deals +3...15 damage. Remove 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: unblockable, removes a stance.

Keen Arrow.description: Bow Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +5...15 damage. If you land a critical hit, you deal an additional +5...30 damage.
Keen Arrow.concise: Bow Attack. Deals +5...15 damage. Deals +5...30 more damage if you land a critical hit.

Light of Deliverance.description: Elite Spell. All party members are healed for 5...70 Health. All your Smiting Prayers are disabled for 20 seconds.
Light of Deliverance.concise: Elite Spell. Heals entire party for 5...70. Disables your Smiting Prayers (20 seconds).

Lyssa's Haste.description: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 3...15 seconds, your Dervish enchantments recharge 33% faster. When you activate this enchantment, all adjacent foes are interrupted. When this enchantment ends, all adjacent foes are interrupted. 50% failure chance unless Wind Prayers 5 or higher.
Lyssa's Haste.concise: Flash Enchantment Spell. (3...15 seconds.) Your Dervish enchantments recharge 33% faster. Initial Effect: interrupts all adjacent foes. End Effect: interrupts all adjacent foes. (50% failure chance unless Wind Prayers 5 or higher.)

Mending Refrain.description: Echo. For 15 seconds, you have +2...3 Health regeneration. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on you.
Mending Refrain.concise: Echo. (15 seconds.) You gain +2...3 Health regeneration. Renewal: whenever a chant or shout ends on you.

Mighty Throw.description: Spear Attack. Your spear moves three times faster. If it hits, you deal +10...40 damage.
Mighty Throw.concise: Spear Attack. Deals +10...40 damage. This spear moves three times faster.

Mirage Cloak.description: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 1...7 seconds, you have a 30...60% chance to block incoming attacks. When you cast this enchantment, all nearby foes are struck for 10...40 earth damage.
Mirage Cloak.concise: Flash Enchantment Spell. (1...7 seconds.) You have 30...60% chance to block. Initial Effect: deals 10...40 earth damage to nearby foes.

Mirror of Disenchantment.description: Spell. Remove one enchantment from target foe. All of that foe's party members also lose that same enchantment.
Mirror of Disenchantment.concise: Spell. Removes one enchantment from target foe. That foe's party members also lose this enchantment.

Mistrust.description: Hex Spell. For 6 seconds, the next spell that target foe casts on one of your allies fails and deals 10...60 damage to that foe and 75% of that damage to all nearby foes.
Mistrust.concise: Hex Spell. (6 seconds.) The next spell that target foe casts on one of your allies fails and deals 10...60 damage to target and 75% of that damage to nearby foes.

Mystic Corruption.description: Flash Enchantment Spell. All adjacent foes suffer from Disease for 2...6 seconds. For 20 seconds, nothing happens. Disease duration is doubled if you are enchanted when you activate this skill. When this enchantment ends, all party members in earshot are cured of Disease.
Mystic Corruption.concise: Flash Enchantment Spell. (20 seconds.) Initial Effect: all adjacent foes are Diseased (2...6 seconds). Double duration if you are already enchanted. End Effect: party members in earshot lose Disease.

Mystic Healing.description: Spell. You are healed for 5...65 Health. Also heals all enchanted party members for 5...65 Health.
Mystic Healing.concise: Spell. Heals you for 5...65. Heals all enchanted party members for 5...65 Health.

Mystic Regeneration.description: Enchantment Spell. For 5...20 seconds, you have +1...4 Health regeneration for each enchantment (maximum of 3) on you.
Mystic Regeneration.concise: Enchantment Spell. (5...20 seconds.) You have +1...4 Health regeneration for each enchantment (maximum of 3) on you.

Onslaught.description: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. For 2...8 seconds, you attack and gain adrenaline 25% faster.
Onslaught.concise: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. (2...8 seconds.) You attack and gain adrenaline 25% faster.

Pious Assault.description: Melee Attack. You remove 1 Dervish enchantment. If a Dervish enchantment was removed, this skill recharges 75% faster and adjacent foes take 15...40 damage.
Pious Assault.concise: Melee Attack. Removes 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Removal Effect: this skill recharges 75% faster and adjacent foes take 15...40 damage.

Pious Restoration.description: Spell. You gain 80...150 Health and remove 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed in this way, you also lose 1 hexes.
Pious Restoration.concise: Spell. Gain 80...150 Health and remove 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal effect: lose 1 hexes.

Recovery.description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...10 spirit. Conditions on allies within range of this spirit expire 20...50% faster. This spirit dies after 30...60 seconds.
Recovery.concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...60 second lifespan). Conditions on allies in range expire 20...50% faster.

Savannah Heat.description: Elite Spell. You create Savannah Heat at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, all nearby foes take 5...20 fire damage for each second this spell has been in effect.
Savannah Heat.concise: Elite Spell. Deals 5...20 fire damage for each second since casting this spell (5 seconds). Hits foes near target's initial location.

Signet of Clumsiness.description: Signet. If target foe is attacking, that foe and all adjacent foes are interrupted and take 15...60 damage. Any foes using attack skills are knocked down.
Signet of Clumsiness.concise: Signet. Interrupts an attack for target foe and all adjacent foes. Interruption effect: deals 15...60 damage; knocks down foes using attack skills.

Signet of Ghostly Might.description: Elite Signet. Target allied summoned creature's attacks deal 5...35 more damage. After 10 seconds, that creature is destroyed.
Signet of Ghostly Might.concise: Elite Signet. Target allied summoned creature deals +5...35 damage. That creature is destroyed after 10 seconds.

Signet of Return.description: Signet. Resurrect target party member with 5...20% Health and 1...4% Energy for each party member within earshot.
Signet of Return.concise: Signet. Resurrects target party member (5...20% Health and 1...4% Energy for each party member in earshot).

Soldier's Stance.description: Elite Stance. For 4...10 seconds, you attack 33% faster while under the effects of a shout or chant.
Soldier's Stance.concise: Elite Stance. (4...10 seconds.) You attack 33% faster while under the effects of a shout or chant.

Song of Restoration.description: Elite Chant. For 10 seconds, the next time each party member within earshot uses a skill, that party member gains 45...110 Health.
Song of Restoration.concise: Elite Chant. (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain 45...110 Health with their next skill.

triggers: You or ally uses a skill

Spiritual Pain.description: Spell. Target foe takes 5...40 damage. All hostile summoned creatures in the area of that foe take 25...125 damage.
Spiritual Pain.concise: Spell. Deals 5...40 damage. Deals 25...125 damage to hostile summoned creatures in the area of target foe.

Tease.description: Elite Spell. If target foe is using a skill, that foe and other foes in the area are interrupted and you steal 0...5 Energy from all foes in the area.
Tease.concise: Elite Spell. Interrupts a skill. Interruption effect: also interrupts other foes in the area, and you steal 0...5 Energy from all foes in the area.

Twin Moon Sweep.description: Melee Attack. You lose 1 Dervish enchantment and gain 10...20 Health. If an enchantment is lost in this way, you cannot be blocked, you strike twice, with each strike doing 25% less damage than normal, and you gain an additional 10...30 Health.
Twin Moon Sweep.concise: Melee Attack. Remove 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Gain 10...20 Health. Removal effect: unblockable, attack twice, each strike doing 25% less damage, and gain 10...30 more Health.

Visions of Regret.description: Elite Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, target foe and adjacent foes take 10...30 damage whenever they use a skill and 5...40 additional damage if not under the effects of another Mesmer hex.
Visions of Regret.concise: Elite Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to target (10 seconds). These foes take 10...30 damage whenever they use a skill and 5...40 additional damage if not under the effects of another Mesmer hex.

Web of Disruption.description: Hex Spell. Interrupt target foe. For 10 seconds, target foe is hexed with Web of Disruption. When this hex ends, that foe is interrupted again.
Web of Disruption.concise: Hex Spell. (10 seconds.) Initial effect: interrupts a skill. End effect: interrupts a skill.

Whirling Charge.description: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 1...6 seconds, you move 33% faster than normal. The next time you strike a foe, all other nearby foes take 10...50 cold damage and this enchantment ends.
Whirling Charge.concise: Flash Enchantment Spell. (1...6 seconds.) You move 33% faster. Deal 10...50 cold damage to all other nearby foes the next time you hit a foe and this enchantment ends.

Wounding Strike.description: Elite Scythe Attack. If this attack hits, target foe suffers from Bleeding for 5...20 seconds, and you lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed, target foe also suffers from a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
Wounding Strike.concise: Elite Scythe Attack. Inflicts Bleeding condition (5...20 seconds). Removes 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal effect: inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds).

Agony.description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...8 spirit. This spirit causes 3...10 Health loss each second to foes within earshot. This spirit loses 3...10 Health for each foe hurt in this way. This spirit dies after 30...90 seconds.
Agony.concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...8 spirit (30...90 second lifespan). Causes 3...10 Health loss each second to foes in earshot. This spirit loses 3...10 Health for each foe that loses Health.

Anthem of Disruption.description: Chant. For 1...10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each ally within earshot also interrupts an action.
Anthem of Disruption.concise: Chant. (1...10 seconds.) Allies in earshot interrupt an action with their next attack skill.

Aura Slicer.description: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you inflict Bleeding for 5...15 seconds. If you are enchanted, you also inflict Cracked Armor for 1...10 seconds.
Aura Slicer.concise: Melee Attack. (5...15 seconds.) Inflicts Bleeding condition. Also inflicts Cracked Armor (1...10 seconds) if you are enchanted.

Calculated Risk.description: Hex Spell. For 3...12 seconds, target foe's attacks do +10 damage, but there is a 50% chance that the damage from each attack will be done to that foe instead. (Maximum 15...60 damage.)
Calculated Risk.concise: Hex Spell. Target foe does +10 damage with attacks (3...12 seconds). There is a 50% chance that the damage from each attack (maximum 15...60) will be done to that foe instead.

Farmer's Scythe.description: Scythe Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +5...35 damage. If you hit more than one foe, this attack recharges instantly.
Farmer's Scythe.concise: Scythe Attack. Deals +5...35 damage. Instant recharge if you hit more than one foe.

Masochism.description: Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, you gain 1...3 Energy whenever you sacrifice Health.
Masochism.concise: Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) You gain 1...3 Energy whenever you sacrifice Health.

Pious Fury.description: Stance. Remove 1 Dervish enchantment. For 1...5 seconds, you attack 25% faster. If an enchantment was removed, this stance lasts twice as long.
Pious Fury.concise: Stance. (1...5 seconds.) You attack 25% faster and remove 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: this stance lasts twice as long.

Rejuvenation.description: Binding Ritual. Create a level 1...16 spirit. This spirit heals all party members within earshot for 3...10 Health each second. This spirit loses 3...10 Health for each party member healed in this way. This spirit dies after 30...90 seconds.
Rejuvenation.concise: Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1...16 spirit (30...90 second lifespan). Heals party members in earshot for 3...10 each second. Healing cost: this spirit loses 3...10 Health.

Signet of Deadly Corruption.description: Signet. Must follow a dual attack. Target foe takes 5...35 damage for each condition on that foe (maximum 130 damage).
Signet of Deadly Corruption.concise: Signet. Deals 5...35 damage (maximum 130) for each condition on target foe. Must follow a dual attack.

Signet of Pious Restraint.description: Signet. Lose 1 Dervish enchantment and Cripple target foe 5...15 seconds. If an enchantment was removed, this skill recharges 50% faster.
Signet of Pious Restraint.concise: Signet. (5...15 seconds.) Cripples target foe and removes 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: recharges 50% faster.

Slippery Ground.description: Spell. If target foe is Blind or moving, that foe is knocked down. (50% failure chance with Water Magic 4 or less.)
Slippery Ground.concise: Spell. Causes knock-down if this foe is Blind or moving. 50% failure chance unless Water Magic 5 or higher.

Sloth Hunter's Shot.description: Bow Attack. If this attack hits, target foe takes +5...15 damage. If that foe is not using a skill, Sloth Hunter's Shot does an additional +5...20 damage.
Sloth Hunter's Shot.concise: Bow Attack. Deals +5...15 damage. Deals +5...20 more damage if target foe is not using a skill.

Smiter's Boon.description: Enchantment Spell. For 4 seconds, your Smiting Prayers have double the Divine Favor bonus.
Smiter's Boon.concise: Enchantment Spell. (4 seconds.) Your Smiting Prayers have double Divine Favor healing bonus.

Wandering Eye.description: Hex Spell. For 4 seconds, the next time target foe attacks, that attack is interrupted and all nearby foes take 10...92 damage.
Wandering Eye.concise: Hex Spell. (4 seconds.) Interrupts target foe's next attack. Interruption effect: 10...92 damage to nearby foes.
